scope: Every sentence in Sections IV-X that reports a numerical result (percentages, times, rates, counts with units, or decimal values).
method: Numbers in comparison records were checked earlier against the PDFs (data/within-study-comparisons.json). Numbers taken from the 2026-11-04 coverage additions (K01-K16) were also re-read on the physical PDF page named in card_locator. Source excerpts remain local.
